server.title: Your server
server.description: YGO Deck Builder is self-hosted: enter the address of your instance (the one you open in your browser).
server.hint: HTTPS by default. On your local network, type the full address, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000
server.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid address.
server.notAnInstance: This server doesn't answer like a YGO Deck Builder instance.
